mapper.select: select line_id from sales_plan_line where plan_id = #{planId} and deleted = 0

SELECT l.line_id, p.plan_no, p.customer, p.plan_month, l.product_id, l.product_name, l.total_quantity, l.forecast_quantity, l.opening_inventory, l.status AS line_status, l.version, d.delivery_date, d.plan_quantity, COALESCE(ps.scheduled_quantity, 0) AS scheduledQuantity FROM sales_plan_line l JOIN sales_plan p ON p.plan_id = l.plan_id AND p.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sales_plan_delivery d ON d.line_id = l.line_id AND d.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT line_id, SUM(quantity) AS scheduled_quantity FROM prod_schedule WHERE status >= 1 GROUP BY line_id ) ps ON ps.line_id = l.line_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT line_id, MIN(delivery_date) AS first_delivery FROM sales_plan_delivery WHERE deleted = 0 GROUP BY line_id ) fd ON fd.line_id = l.line_id WHERE l.deleted = 0 AND l.status IN (1, 2, 3) ORDER BY fd.first_delivery IS NULL, fd.first_delivery
